text:
alex: Heads up — 10:18 UTC alert `serving_high_error_rate` routed to infra oncall twice in the last hour. It looks like it's for inference-serving (model/gpu pool). Anyone own the underlying metric? Where are logs/traces so we can triage quickly? Grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/serving/serving-overview?orgId=1&from=now-1h

oncall-bot: Alert routed to eng-infra according to PD map v2.0. See /integrations/pagerduty

sarah: I can take a look. That metric is `inference.request_errors.count` from prometheus cluster-inference. Traces are in Tempo: https://tempo.redwood.ai/trace/ (search by trace id in logs). Also we have a per-pool dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/serving/pool-latency?var-pool=redwood-gpu-1

alex: thanks. Do we want this to route to eng-runtime instead of eng-infra? infra can't do model rollouts but runtime team can. Also runbook link is stale: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/serving-error-rate

maria: yeah, agree it should go to eng-runtime. To change PD mapping we need a small update in the slack->pd config. I'll propose a mapping patch, but need owners' signoff. Quick snippet to adjust routing in the PD mapping config:
```
- alert: serving_high_error_rate
  match: {team: serving}
  route: eng-runtime-oncall
```
I'll open a tiny PR against infra/alerting-config and ping reviewers. If you want interim suppression for noisy bursts we can add a `for: 5m` to the Prom rule.

jonah: FYI: if you add `for`, make sure the alert still respects SLOs. Suggest `for: 2m` first.

sarah: I'll own the follow-up. Alex, can you drop the incident link or paste a sample trace so I can triage? If we change routing, update the runbook and notify eng-oncall channel.

alex: pasted trace id 7f1a2c3b. Small follow-up ticket: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENGINF-2745

maria: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/infra-alerts/pull/201 — added routing and for:2m. @sarah please review. I'll coordinate PD escalation schedule change after merge.

sarah: reviewing now, :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Notification: PR merged by maria — infra-alerts#201

alex: great, thanks all. Will update runbook once Sarah confirms root cause.
